name: Netlify
one_liner: Web hosting and deployment platform for sites and apps, with a REST API and official MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal access tokens sent as Bearer tokens. OAuth2 apps for public integrations via app.netlify.com/authorize. The MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.
access_notes: Personal access tokens and OAuth apps are created self-serve in user settings. Plan gating and costs are not stated on the pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve tokens and OAuth2 apps, a documented REST API with an OpenAPI spec, and an official MCP server. Plan gating is not stated on the pages.

identity.quote: Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps, manage form submissions

auth.quote: Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication. All requests must use HTTPS.
Every method ends with a bearer token that acts as a Netlify user.

access.quote: Name it, pick an expiration date, and, if your team uses SAML SSO, choose whether to allow access to that team.

api_surface.quote: You can make up to 500 requests per minute for most requests.

mcp.quote: Netlify MCP Server follows the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable code agents to use the Netlify API and CLI

needs_human_reason: Plan gating and pricing are not stated on the fetched pages. Confirm on netlify.com pricing before building.
